ReplaceCore.Name: Replace core weather
ReplaceCore.Hint: Disable Foundry's built-in weather effects so Weather Forging renders all weather. Scenes with core weather set are adopted automatically.

Quality.Name: Effect quality
Quality.Hint: How many particles and effects your computer renders. Affects only you.

UIEffects.Name: Weather-reactive interface
UIEffects.Hint: Tint the interface and add frost, wet and storm effects according to the weather. Affects only you.

ReduceMotion.Name: Reduce flashes and motion
ReduceMotion.Hint: Greatly dims lightning flashes. Recommended for photosensitive players.

IndoorMasking.Name: Hide weather indoors
IndoorMasking.Hint: Use Foundry's weather occlusion so precipitation and ground cover do not appear under roofs or inside regions with the Suppress Weather behavior.

AffectDarkness.Name: Weather affects scene lighting
AffectDarkness.Hint: Clouds, rain and fog darken the scene through Foundry's lighting (so light sources matter) and lightning briefly lights it up. Client-side only; the scene's own darkness setting is never changed.

ShowWidget.Name: Show weather widget
ShowWidget.Hint: A small, draggable readout of the current weather, temperature and wind.

Editor.Title: Weather Editor
Editor.NameRequired: Give the preset a name first.

Welcome.Title: Welcome to Weather Forging
Welcome.Tagline: Cinematic weather for your table: on the map, in the interface and in the rules.
Welcome.Step1: Open the panel: Scene Controls → Lighting → cloud icon, or click the weather widget.
Welcome.Step2: Pick a preset and a transition time. Set 0 s to see the full effect instantly.
Welcome.Step3: Keep weather out of interiors: draw a Region and add the Suppress Weather behavior.
Welcome.Step4: Make your own weather in the Weather editor and save it as a preset.
Welcome.Hint: This window appears after each update. Reopen it any time from the module settings.
